worlds.name: The Modern Sovereign World
worlds.summary: An entirely fictional modern world with fictional countries, corporations, families, institutions and international alliances. It resembles contemporary civilization, with advanced technology, international finance, multinational corporations, modern governments and established criminal organizations.
worlds.geography: Global influence structure: Level 1 — Ordinary wealth: millionaires, entrepreneurs, celebrities and wealthy individuals. Level 2 — National dynasties: Sterling-type industrial and financial families. Level 3 — International corporations: multinational conglomerates and financial groups. Level 4 — International power blocs: political, industrial, financial and security alliances. Level 5 — Hidden dynasties: secret international networks and competing family empires. Level 6 — Vesper Sovereign Dynasty: the world's most influential private dynasty.
